scoring_justification: Recompute inflection point and L2 deviation from analytical model from raw CSV; both are derived from the agent's submitted artifact without trusting self-reported numbers.

outputs.description: CSV table of order parameter for varying relative interaction strength. The checker extracts the simulated order parameter curve to locate inflection point and compares to the paper's threshold within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: Only the simulated order parameter defines the scored inflection point and L2 deviation.
